NTP Pool Vendor Zone

If you are adding NTP servers to the pool, please see information for joining the NTP Pool.

You need a vendor zone if you are distributing devices or software to 3rd parties or otherwise don't have them in your network and under your control.

If your devices are all under your control and management you do not need a vendor zone.

If you are distributing or testing less than 50 units (hardware or software) in the next year, you don't need a vendor pool, you can just use the regular host names.

You must not use the NTP Pool if your life, business or community could be harmed by your systems having incorrect time. This is a service run by thousands of volunteers around the world. Please see the terms of service. Only continue if you have read and agreed to them.
